# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No code changes applied. The review (cr2) approved the implementation without amendments. The two prior amendments (K_LA cap ordering fix and tautological test rewrite) were already applied in the plan_and_implement stage of this completion round and passed review. All 38 relevant tests (12 co2_exchange + 21 chemistry + 5 dissolved_oxygen) pass, formatting is clean.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Confirmed review outcome is 'approved' with no follow_up_or_amendments — no fixes needed
2. [Completed] Ran cargo test --test co2_exchange --test chemistry --test dissolved_oxygen: 38/38 passed
3. [Completed] Ran cargo fmt --check -p tank_core: clean

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --test co2_exchange: 12 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test chemistry: 21 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test dissolved_oxygen: 5 passed, 0 failed
- cargo fmt --check -p tank_core: clean, exit 0

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
